data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Both the decentralized and centralized architectures are vulnerable to correlated failures through different mechanisms, but the distinguishing evidence is found in the pattern of failure onset: truly independent failures exhibit exponential inter-arrival times and Poisson-distributed failure counts, while hidden shared causes produce clustered failures with heavy-tailed inter-arrival distributions.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the failure rate is non-stationary (e.g., due to diurnal traffic patterns), then the Poisson assumption may not hold even for independent failures.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the hidden shared cause produces failures that are spread out over time (e.g., a slow-burning security vulnerability), then the clustering may not be detectable through inter-arrival time analysis.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the system has adaptive load shedding that masks the true failure rate, then the observed failure pattern may not reflect the underlying independence structure.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The mathematical structure of failure events reveals whether they are truly independent or share a hidden common cause. If failures are independent and identically distributed, their arrival process follows a Poisson distribution, with exponential inter-arrival times and failure counts that follow a Poisson distribution. If there is a hidden shared cause (e.g., a common dependency that is intermittently failing), failures will cluster: the inter-arrival times will be heavy-tailed (e.g., follow a power-law or Weibull distribution), and the failure counts will be overdispersed relative to a Poisson distribution. This statistical signature is architecture-independent: it applies equally to decentralized and centralized systems. The resilience comparison then depends on which architecture is better able to detect and mitigate the clustered failures that indicate a hidden shared cause.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
